title: OSHWC bounded Central/Maharashtra source-readiness candidate
limitations: The Code and Central Rules reuse existing Wave 5A source-identity registrations; they are not represented here as newly acquired full controlled files.
The commencement record and both Maharashtra State-rule records are curated official source identities pending exact full-file Drive mirrors and source-file approval.
The Maharashtra OSHWC (Labour) Rules, 2026 and Maharashtra OSHWC (Factories and Other Ports) Rules, 2026 are published drafts only and cannot be treated as final or operative.
Wave 5F covers generic establishment source readiness only. Contract labour, inter-State migrant workers and other Chapter XI or industry-special routes are deferred to later bounded packs.

The candidate cannot decide OSHWC applicability, establishment classification, worker-count thresholds, registration or licensing liability, safety-standard sufficiency, working hours, leave, incident-report sufficiency, inspection, penalty, prosecution or remedy.
nextControlledAction: Acquire and fingerprint exact full OSHWC Code, Central Rules and commencement files plus any final Maharashtra State rules when issued; then obtain qualified legal, privacy, RAG and source-file review before expanding beyond generic establishment source readiness.
